name: domain-experts
description: OneStudio's domain expert agent toolkit — one plugin: 5 skills (domain-creator, domain-eval, domain-capture, domain-contribute, domain-chat) plus Nala, the venture-building reference agent. Build, evaluate, evolve, contribute, and chat with domain expert agents in Claude Code.

plugins.name: domain-experts
plugins.description: The toolkit — 5 skills (domain-creator, domain-eval, domain-capture, domain-contribute, domain-chat) plus Nala, the venture-building reference agent. domain-creator includes a PRD-first path: read `docs/prd.md` and propose framing (with strict domain-widening so the agent is built around the wider category, never the product the PRD describes). Install this to build or maintain domain expert agents.
